name: White Enigma
source:
When "I" woke up, I had lost all memories.

The snow and mysteries lie thick, like they want to cover this strange mansion.
The date in the newspaper was December, 25th- Christmas.

[from the official [url=http://hanikamuaisuman.web.fc2.com/game/we/we.html]homepage[/url]]
translation:
当“我”醒来时，我失去了所有的记忆。

厚厚的积雪和神秘气息，仿佛要将这座陌生的宅邸遮盖起来。
报纸上的日期是12月25日——圣诞节。

【来自官方[url=http://hanikamuaisuman.web.fc2.com/game/we/we.html]主页[/url]]
